title: A Unit Mix-Up Left A Plane With 20,400 Pounds Of Fuel
hook: A unit mix-up loaded 20,400 pounds when the plane needed 45,000.
closing: Units look abstract until the missing fuel is carrying people.
question: Where have mixed units failed you?

segments.say: Non-metric countries contain 5% of people; the other 95% use metric.
A unit error dropped the orbiter from 226 kilometers planned to 57 actual.
The plane loaded 20,400 pounds but needed 45,000, leaving less than half.
